name: Meluri–Avangkhu National Highway
significance: NH 202K is a branch of NH 202. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one leaves NH 202 at Akhegwo, near Meluri, and runs to Avangkhu on the Myanmar border.

relatedRoads.label: NH 202 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Mokokchung to New Lambulane
